name: multi-tenant-api-rate-limiter
description: Multi-tenant API Rate Limiter SaaS Platform with Microservices Architecture
author: Shaikh

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "ADMIN,GATEWAY,LIMITER,ANALYTICS,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue,bgMagenta,bgCyan,bgGreen,bgYellow,bgRed" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:limiter" "npm run dev:analytics" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "ADMIN,GATEWAY,LIMITER,ANALYTICS,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue,bgMagenta,bgCyan,bgGreen,bgYellow,bgRed" "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:limiter" "npm run start:analytics" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:admin && npm run build:gateway && npm run build:limiter && npm run build:analytics && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:services: cd microservices/admin-service && npm install && cd ../gateway-service && npm install && cd ../ratelimit-service && npm install && cd ../analytics-service && npm install && cd ../dummy-backend-service && npm install && cd ../../frontend && npm install
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && npm run clean:build
scripts.docker:clean: docker compose down -v && docker system prune -af
scripts.prisma:generate: cd microservices/admin-service && npx prisma generate && cd ../analytics-service && npx prisma generate
scripts.prisma:migrate:dev: cd microservices/admin-service && npx prisma migrate dev && cd ../analytics-service && npx prisma migrate dev
